Establishing template contents clears the element's form owner: theorem_create_template_contents_frame (every other field of the template is kept) is false for an element with a form owner.

remove keeps the same siblings but rotates them (length, membership and absence of duplicates are as before, so only the order is wrong): theorem_remove_keeps_order (the old parent's children are the old ones with the entry at node's index taken out, in order) is false with two siblings left.

adopt never detaches the node from its old parent, so moving a node leaves it listed there (and twice, when moved within one parent): theorem_append_wf and theorem_insert_wf (the parent's children are those after step 7.1, one more) are false.
previous sibling is the parent's first child, not the one just before: theorem_insert_before_wf (child's previous sibling is the node inserted before it) is false at index 2.
last child is the first child: theorem_append_wf (the appended node is its parent's last child) is false once there are two children.
append data puts the new data before the old: theorem_append_data_wf (the data is the old data followed by the new) is false for a non-empty text.
